LanguageData.AT_EnabledTip: Display counters in the native bottom-right control stack. Takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.AT_ShowFpsTip: Rendered frames per second, using RimWorld's existing smoothed frame timing.
LanguageData.AT_ShowTpsTip: Completed simulation ticks per real second, measured over the sampling window.
LanguageData.AT_ShowTargetTip: Read the current tick rate multiplier from the game; supports mods that patch this multiplier. Forced slowdown and idle speed changes update at the TPS interval.
LanguageData.AT_ShowPercentTip: Actual TPS divided by target TPS. Short windows and catch-up ticks can briefly exceed 100%.
LanguageData.AT_ShowFrameTimeTip: RimWorld's smoothed total frame time, also used for FPS. This includes frame limiting and waiting; it is not CPU-only work time.
LanguageData.AT_ShowTickTimeTip: RimWorld's existing smoothed tick execution time. Unlike actual TPS, it excludes most waiting between ticks.
LanguageData.AT_ShowWorldTip: Use the same native controls hook in colony and world view. The main menu never displays counters.
LanguageData.AT_HidePausedTip: Hide both FPS and TPS during manual or forced pause; otherwise FPS remains live and TPS reads Paused.
LanguageData.AT_TooltipsTip: Generate the translated explanation only when the counter area is first hovered.
LanguageData.AT_SuppressVanillaTip: Skip the equivalent vanilla FPS/TPS debug row only while this mod actually shows that metric. Does not change debug preferences or hide other mods' counters.
LanguageData.AT_SamplingInfo: Longer intervals reduce formatting work and make TPS steadier. Sampling is constant-time, without per-tick patches. Recommended: FPS 0.5 s, TPS 1.0 s.
LanguageData.AT_FpsIntervalTip: How often to read the game's existing FPS statistics and refresh display text. Range: 0.1–5 seconds.
LanguageData.AT_TpsIntervalTip: Measure completed ticks across this many real seconds. Short windows react faster but are noisier at low frame rates.
LanguageData.AT_DecimalsTip: Display zero, one, or two decimal places for FPS and TPS. Timing details always use two decimals.
LanguageData.AT_MethodInfo: FPS = 1000 / the game's smoothed frame time in milliseconds. TPS = completed tick difference / elapsed wall-clock seconds. Target TPS = current game tick rate multiplier × 60. Tick cost is read from the game's existing average. Actual TPS is not a theoretical speed estimated from tick cost.
LanguageData.AT_PauseInfo: Pausing immediately clears stale TPS. After resume, speed/target changes, save changes or a long UI gap, TPS shows a dash until a full fresh window is available. Normal windows may include partial stalls, which correctly lower actual TPS. All counters use real time rather than game time.
LanguageData.AT_Horizontal: Put FPS and TPS on one row
LanguageData.AT_HorizontalTip: Use two right-aligned columns on a single native row. Enable automatic width when displaying timing details.
LanguageData.AT_TpsFirstTip: Put TPS above FPS in vertical layout, or to the left of FPS in horizontal layout.
LanguageData.AT_TinyFontTip: Choose RimWorld's Tiny font instead of its default Small font. UI scale is still controlled by the game.
LanguageData.AT_AutoWidthTip: Measure text only when its contents or font change. The panel expands left and is kept within the screen.
LanguageData.AT_WidthTip: Used as a fixed width when automatic fitting is disabled. Very narrow widths can clip detailed values.
LanguageData.AT_RowHeightTip: Each row reserves this height in the original controls stack. Default 26 matches vanilla.
LanguageData.AT_RightInsetTip: Move the text left without overlapping the date or time buttons. Default zero matches vanilla alignment.
LanguageData.AT_GapTip: Extra space between the counter block and time controls. This space is reserved in the stack.
LanguageData.AT_BackgroundAlphaTip: Optional plain black background. Zero uses the native transparent appearance and skips the extra draw call.
LanguageData.AT_ColorizeTip: Healthy, warning, and critical colors follow the thresholds below. Paused or warming-up TPS remains gray.
LanguageData.AT_GoodFpsTip: FPS at or above this value uses the healthy color. This is a display threshold, not a frame-rate cap.
LanguageData.AT_WarningFpsTip: FPS below this value uses the critical color. Values between this and the healthy threshold use warning color.
LanguageData.AT_GoodTpsRatioTip: Compare actual TPS to the game's current target rather than a fixed target of 60.
LanguageData.AT_WarningTpsRatioTip: A lower target percentage uses the critical color. Cannot exceed the healthy percentage.
LanguageData.AT_HelpMeaningText: FPS describes visual smoothness; TPS describes simulation progress. A high FPS does not guarantee high TPS. Parentheses show the current target, for example TPS: 180 (180). Brief percentages over 100% are possible with tick catch-up. No settings here accelerate simulation or change game speed.
LanguageData.AT_HelpPerformanceText: Three UI-only Harmony patches. No per-tick patches, background threads, polling tasks, pawn scans, or save components in this mod. FPS reuses native timing; TPS reads tick deltas. The target multiplier is queried at the TPS interval or on pause/speed changes because the game's getter can check colonist activity. Text and widths are cached. Sampling/drawing runs only on repaint, at most once per frame. Tooltip text is lazy. Disabled counters skip collection. Native UI rendering and changed text still have a small cost; this mod does not promise zero overhead.
LanguageData.AT_HelpCompatibilityText: Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony 1.7. No DLC required. Counters are inserted above the native time controls and reserve space before date/weather/letters are laid out. GUI color, font, alignment and wrapping are restored after drawing. No save data is added; safe to add/remove. Other mods that replace the entire controls stack may need a compatibility patch. Disable other FPS/TPS overlays if they duplicate this display.
LanguageData.AT_HelpPresetsText: Defaults restores every setting. Low overhead uses 1 s FPS and 2 s TPS refresh, with no timing details, percentages, colors or background. Detailed enables both counters, target, percentage and timing details at 0.5 s / 1 s. Layout and visibility preferences are preserved by these two presets. Changes apply immediately and are saved when closing Mod settings.
LanguageData.AT_OverlayTip: FPS: rendered frames per real second, from the game's smoothed frame time. TPS: completed simulation ticks per real second. Parentheses: current target TPS. ms/f: total frame time (includes waiting). ms/t: tick execution time. Paused clears stale TPS; a dash means a fresh sample is warming up. Configure in Options → Mod settings → FPS & TPS.
